insights.one_liner: Royal IHC is a Dutch shipbuilder in Kinderdijk, now working on Navy submarines under a new CEO while rebuilding its finances.

culture.text: A Dutch shipbuilding company based in Kinderdijk and Sliedrecht.
Its data team says it cares about how data improves decisions, not about the number of dashboards.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Both current jobs in Kinderdijk (data and engineering) don't require Dutch, and both show pay.

growth.text: Signed its first contract to help build the new Orka-class submarines for the Royal Netherlands Navy.
Increased its guarantee facilities to EUR 430 million.

worth_knowing.text: Erik-Jan Bijvank, a former Fugro and Stork executive, started as CEO, replacing Derk te Bokkel.
The outgoing CEO said Royal IHC is now mainly a systems integrator.
